place.name: Tiilikkajärvi National Park
place.description: Tiilikkajärvi National Park (Finnish: Tiilikkajärven kansallispuisto) is a national park in Finland, located both in Rautavaara, North Savo and Sotkamo, Kainuu. It was established in 1982 and covers 72 square kilometres (28 sq mi) after its expansion in 2023, making it the second largest national park in southern Finland.
